gaps.sentence: The document is of great ___ (IMPORTANT) to the case.
He was ___ (COURAGE) enough to speak first.
The problem was ___ (SIMPLE) a matter of bad timing.
gaps.explanation: 'Simply a matter of' = only a matter of.
'Arrived damaged' — participle describing the state of the parcel.

gaps.sentence: The plane made a hard but ___ (SUCCESS) landing.
The castle is ___ (SIGHT) for miles in every direction.
gaps.explanation: 'Be visible' = can be seen; 'visibility' is the noun for how far you can see.

gaps.sentence: The palace is open to ___ (VISIT) all year.
The team's ___ (LOSE) came as a shock to the fans.
gaps.explanation: 'Their loss' — the noun for a defeat or disappearance.
